title: Commute record
description: One row of HW_049_maruf.2052302.csv: a single student's trip on a single day.

student_id.description: Student identifier (S1 to S4 in the current data).

date.description: Trip date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Currently 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-30, weekdays only.

mode.description: Transport mode used for the trip.

cost_eur.description: Trip cost in euros. 0 for Walk and Bicycle.

arrival_margin_min.description: Minutes between arrival and the deadline. Positive = early, negative = late.
